[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 1>. The rings of light ripple slowly outward across the pale sky around the seated figure. The camera pushes in toward the figure at a slow, steady speed in one continuous move. The figure opens their eyes, rises to their feet on the water and lifts their arms into a slow spin, and each step sends a new ring of color spreading across the lake.
